name: hedgehog
description: Hedgehog Camp trading game (MIT 2026, powered by StockTrak): account, positions, orders, history and CSV exports, quotes and option chains, rankings, H-Token rewards; optional trading (stocks, ETFs, options, 22 option strategies) behind a settings switch, game-rule guardrails and per-order confirmation. Calls run from the user's own StockTrak tab; no credentials leave the browser.

fields.label: Enable trading (place, cancel, edit orders; exercise options)
fields.help: Off by default. Every order counts toward your scored Hedgehog Camp game. While off, the trading tools are hidden from the model.

fields.label: Don't ask me before each order (not recommended)
fields.help: Off by default: the plugin itself asks in the chat before every order and exercise, and only proceeds when you click 'Place it'.

fields.label: Keep the StockTrak session alive (read-only ping every 4 min)
fields.help: Off by default. While a StockTrak tab with the bookmarklet is open, it asks StockTrak for today's trade notes every 4 minutes using that tab's own login, so an idle session doesn't time out. Never signs in; pauses after 30 minutes with the tab hidden.
